name: Tech Comedy Cartoon - Free iPhone Ka Chakkar 🤣
body:
Fully rigged 2D cartoon comedy short for YouTube.

NO slideshow - every frame is animated in Python with a character rig:
- Jaw-morph lip-sync (mouth moves with the actual voice amplitude)
- Blinking eyes, head bob/tilt, 6 full-body gesture poses
- Parallax backgrounds, meme sticker pops, camera shake/zoom/flash
- 3 distinct AI voices with Hinglish comic timing

1080x1920 vertical MP4, 24fps, ~65 seconds.

Download tech_cartoon_final.mp4 below. To edit the script, expressions, voices or FX, edit story.json in the repo - the GitHub Action re-renders and re-releases the MP4 automatically on push.
